research_question: Using only each official AreCEL train split, what resource sets does the same deterministic add-only greedy algorithm select for Nominal and task-wise PESS at unit-proxy budgets 0, 2, 3, 4, and 5?

scientific_scope.pess_scheme_family: all inclusion-maximal pairwise-disjoint subsets of the task-applicable selected MCV candidates
scientific_scope.pess_aggregation: sum across tasks of each task's worst-case loss
scientific_scope.maintenance_cost: unit additive proxy per candidate, as prescribed for this sweep; not physical PostgreSQL maintenance cost
scientific_scope.case_accounting: 40 labeled dataset/objective/budget cases; each dataset's Nominal/PESS B=0 pair shares the identical empty resource set and objective value and may share one computation while retaining both records
scientific_scope.tie_break: ascending candidate ID, shared by Nominal and PESS
scientific_scope.greedy_rule: start empty; among all remaining feasible single additions choose the largest strictly positive exact objective reduction; stop if no feasible positive addition remains; no swaps, restarts, or forced budget fill

postgresql_measurement.measurement: one empty-statistics baseline plus each full-universe candidate as a singleton, on every task where that pair is statically applicable from train predicates
postgresql_measurement.structured_contract: PR #7 ESS_DIAGNOSTICS JSON parser from the pinned PR #65 adapter; retain query-level raw pre-clamp estimates, statuses, and narrow MCV trace events
postgresql_measurement.query_form: official nonaggregate source SQL adapted to the pinned public.<dataset> table
postgresql_measurement.candidate_universe: all unordered pairs of source schema columns in schema order; train-only support determines task applicability, not candidate shortlist membership
postgresql_measurement.candidate_id: e<left schema index, two digits>_<right schema index, two digits>
postgresql_measurement.statistics: two-column MCV statistics; per-column and per-statistics target 300
postgresql_measurement.analyze_sample: one binary ANALYZE sample exported from a fresh run-local PostgreSQL 16.14 cluster per dataset, then replayed for all singleton configurations and the empty baseline on both measurement clusters
postgresql_measurement.parallel_collection: One run-local PostgreSQL cluster and one query loop per selected worker; all clusters replay identical fixed ANALYZE sample bytes; CLI parallelism is selectable from 1 to min(12, CPU affinity), with the maximum selected by default. Dataset runs remain serial.
postgresql_measurement.claim_limit: source-derived, conditional on the pinned instrumented PostgreSQL control flow; EXPLAIN alone is not treated as proof of statistic use

model_fit.training_truth: read only the official train label array for fitting; use T=max(1,N)
model_fit.forest10: forest10-positive-preclamp-v1; require finite positive baseline and singleton nrows_preclamp before logarithms
model_fit.census13: census13-clamped-log-v2; apply max(1,x) uniformly to raw pre-clamp estimates and train truth during coefficient construction, preserving the existing Census transform
model_fit.dmv11: positive-preclamp-v1; require finite positive baseline and singleton nrows_preclamp; do not introduce a clamp
model_fit.power7: positive-preclamp-v1; require finite positive baseline and singleton nrows_preclamp; do not introduce a clamp
model_fit.coefficients: alpha_i=ln(max(1,n0_i)/T_i) for the clamped Census model and ln(n0_i/T_i) for positive models; beta_ie=ln(n1_ie/n0_i); quantize Decimal natural logs at 1e-18 with precision 80 and ROUND_HALF_EVEN, then convert to exact Fraction strings
model_fit.zero_or_negative_positive_model_input: dataset model fit is INCOMPLETE; do not silently clamp or substitute

resource_envelope.basis: historical full-valid Issue #64 run: 174088 structured calls in 716.951 seconds across two workers (242.82 calls/second); 6408799 allocated compressed observation bytes, or 36.82 bytes/call. These are sizing references, not train measurements.
resource_envelope.stop_rule: run one dataset at a time; stop that attempt at 7.5 hours or 19 GiB allocated disk; never exceed 8 hours or 20 GiB; preserve INCOMPLETE evidence and do not subsample; begin the next dataset only after the prior cluster and run-local data are shut down
resource_envelope.runtime_storage_location: ESS_RUNTIME_PARENT/ess-research/issue99/runs/<run-id>; no observation or build artifact enters Git

revision_2_parallelism_basis.source: the interrupted Issue #99 Forest10 v1 two-worker collection; sizing evidence only, not a completed experiment result
revision_2_parallelism_basis.limitation: linear throughput scaling to 12 clusters is not assumed; protocol v3 raises the per-dataset disk early-stop/hard limits to 9.5/10 GiB, while preserving the same wall limits; any over-cap attempt remains INCOMPLETE

revision_3_resource_envelope.researcher_authorization: increase the per-dataset maximum disk use from 3 GiB to 10 GiB
revision_3_resource_envelope.supersedes: protocol-v2.json for newly started collections; v2 collection records remain valid under their pinned 3/4-GiB caps
revision_3_resource_envelope.early_stop_adjustment_reason: the initial 9-GiB early stop interrupted DMV11 cluster setup with zero observations; observed peaks were below the authorized 10-GiB hard cap, so the early stop was raised to 9.5 GiB while retaining the 10-GiB hard cap

estimated_12_worker_full_run_disk_bytes.basis: 12-worker run peaked at 10497945600 allocated bytes during setup with worker0-worker4 directories present and zero observations; approximate common pre-cluster footprint was 1.08 billion bytes, and the remaining footprint was extrapolated from five visible worker directories to twelve; estimated observation output adds about 77089214 bytes based on the historical compressed-byte-per-call rate
estimated_12_worker_full_run_disk_bytes.evidence_label: Conjecture / Open; no 12-worker cluster setup or observation collection completed

revision_3_resource_envelope.next_parallelism_reason: researcher requested that collection stop while the 12-worker disk requirement is estimated; no further collection attempt is started before the sizing decision

revision_4_authorized_execution.researcher_authorization: use six workers for the remaining DMV11 and Power7 collections and raise the per-dataset maximum disk use to 20 GiB
revision_4_authorized_execution.supersedes: protocol-v3 for newly started collections; prior v2 and v3 collection records remain valid under their pinned limits

pre_run_sizing.basis: The 12-worker DMV11 full-run estimate was 22-24 GiB from a stopped partial setup; halving worker-local cluster copies while retaining shared inputs suggests 12-14 GiB for six workers. Measurement times are historical valid-only estimates and no six-worker speedup is assumed.
pre_run_sizing.evidence_label: Conjecture / Open; execution sizing only, not an observed result

selection_limits.schedule: serial dataset then B ascending then Nominal before PESS; each case is independent and accounted COMPLETE or INCOMPLETE
selection_limits.pess_subset_checks: T * (1 + sum_{j=0}^{min(B,N)-1}(N-j)*2^(j+1)); safe outcome-independent upper bound, where T is 100000
selection_limits.timeout_or_unfinished_round: INCOMPLETE; selected_ids is null; record last completed prefix only for audit

runtime: query-level raw structured baseline/singleton observations with statuses
not_retained: derivable plots or large summary ledgers

supersedes_protocol: protocol-v2.json for newly started collections; protocol-v1 and protocol-v2 remain preserved for their recorded attempts and completed runs

collection_parallelism.selection: collect DATASET --parallelism K; K must be in [1, min(6, CPU affinity count)]
collection_parallelism.default: maximum allowed worker count under the six-worker protocol cap and current process CPU affinity
collection_parallelism.maximum_basis: The researcher selected six workers for remaining DMV11 and Power7 collections. At revision the process had affinity to 12 CPUs, no cgroup CPU quota, 14,297,587,712 bytes MemAvailable, and 54,033,010,688 bytes free on the runtime filesystem. Protocol v4 uses a per-dataset 19-GiB early stop and 20-GiB hard cap; this is a selected execution setting, not a guarantee that each dataset fits.
collection_parallelism.worker_model: one run-local PostgreSQL cluster and one serial query loop per worker
collection_parallelism.sample_contract: the same exported binary ANALYZE sample is replayed to every worker cluster; relation OID and sample identity are checked for every cluster
collection_parallelism.configuration_assignment: empty baseline assigned to worker 0; singleton candidates assigned in descending train support to the least-loaded worker with worker-ID tie break; each worker then runs singleton IDs in ascending order
collection_parallelism.dataset_schedule: datasets remain serial; only within-dataset worker count changed
collection_parallelism.failed_attempt_reuse: all v1/v2 incomplete observations remain separate and are not reused; the v2 DMV11 attempts that stopped during cluster setup have zero observations
